source.method: Figma MCP get_design_context; sample text nodes and visible swatches; screenshots inspected
Figma MCP get_design_context; sample text nodes and visible swatches; screenshots inspected

notes: Plus Jakarta Sans and color/slate-* belong to the presentation board, not quiz presets.
Text Preset 5 Medium style name mentions 100% but its actual text style and visible annotation specify 150%; actual lineHeight=1.5 retained.
rem conversion uses an explicit 16px reference, not an extracted root font-size.
768px/1024px existing Sass breakpoints are template defaults, not confirmed design tokens.

controls.provenance: Значения внутри variant относятся к его nodeId; вложенные объекты имеют собственный nodeId. get_design_context + get_metadata; screenshots просмотрены. Цвета векторов, радиусы badge, strokes и gap уточнены read-only use_figma (Plugin API).
notes: border:null означает strokes:[] — видимой обводки нет; Figma strokeWeight=1 хранится, но без strokes не рисуется.
Обёртки выставочного стенда не являются размерами кнопок.
Selection не имеет обводки, badge нейтральный, справа зелёная галочка; это не Hover & Active.
Dark hover/active, correct и wrong имеют текст буквы #3B4D66, не белый. Цвета не исправлялись.
Submit hover/active — белый слой 50% поверх #A729F5; gap=8 подтверждён Plugin API, хотя отсутствовал в сгенерированном context.
Текст 4.5 : 1 / 2.5 : 1 — содержимое примера в Figma, не результат вычисления контраста.
Размеры относятся к показанным desktop-компонентам; responsive и отдельные focus/disabled состояния здесь не представлены.

secondary.units: px; coordinates relative to parent; rem = px / 16
secondary.provenance: Figma MCP get_metadata + get_design_context with screenshot inspected; precise supplementary properties from read-only use_figma. Each nodeId is the source of its properties. Empty strokes/effects mean none, not default strokeWeight.

notes: 8 and out of 10 are sample text, not an inferred score algorithm.
Shared properties apply to both explicit variant nodeIds; typography comes from respective text nodes.
Shadow cssColor is the get_design_context approximation; figmaRgba preserves exact Plugin API floats.

notification.name: Wrong Answer Notification
notes: Despite the group name, the shown message means no answer selected, not an incorrect submitted answer.
Only Desktop variant is present in this group.

progress.layout: vertical, centered main axis, start cross axis
notes: 300px is the displayed sample width only; no functional percentage or quiz-progress algorithm is specified.
itemSpacing 8 is an API property with only one child; it produces no visible inter-item gap.
No text typography applies.
Dark 285×88 is showcase including 16px padding; intrinsic logo content is 253×56. Badge iconInset is relative to the badge, not raw Figma GROUP coordinate space.

toggle.name: Light/Dark Mode Button
notes: Dark variant includes a 16px showcase wrapper; the switch itself is 48×28, not 160×60.
No text typography applies.

uncertainties: Functional progress percentage and dynamic scoring behavior are not defined by these static samples.
Responsive sizes and states absent from these selected groups are not inferred.
HEX colors normalize Figma RGB floats to 8-bit; exact non-integer light shadow color is preserved separately.
